Three-player IPD · Council. Goal: Finish with more points than Rook and Dove. Your turn: Eight turns. Each turn one move, cooperate or defect, is played against both rivals, optionally casting the council votes Dove authorized to you. Or send Dove a one-letter note naming your ally. Scoring: Per pairing: both cooperate 3/3; defect on a cooperator 5/0; both defect 1/1. Each council vote credited to you is 1 point; Dove authorized you to cast 1 in total. A note to Dove is an ally designation: D for Dove or R for Rook. Rivals: A live player controls each other seat, choosing its actions from its own observations and the game history. You start with 9, Rook with 17, and Dove with 8. Each pairwise move uses the stated payoff table. Dove chooses whether to trade with Rook: trading pays each 3; embargo withholds Rook’s 3.
